'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Terrorism in Australia]]
**[[2025 Bondi Beach shooting]]
***The surviving gunman of the attack on [[Bondi Beach]], [[Australia]], is charged with 59 offences, including 15 counts of [[Murder in Australian law|murder]] and one count of committing a [[Terrorism in Australia|terrorist]] act. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c98nm1ry38jo (BBC News)]
*[[War on drugs]], [[Operation Southern Spear]]
**[[2025 United States military strikes on alleged drug traffickers]]
***The [[United States Southern Command]] says the [[United States Navy|U.S. Navy]] attacked an alleged [[Illegal drug trade|drug smuggling]] boat in the [[Pacific Ocean|Eastern Pacific]], killing at least four people. [https://apnews.com/article/boat-strike-trump-cartels-venezuela-us-military-c647b6b80fe0f0acaab3856f61365ed0 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of the United States]] 
**[[Travel bans under the Trump administrations]]
***[[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] expands the country's existing [[travel ban]] by banning citizens of [[Burkina Faso]], [[Mali]], [[South Sudan]], and [[Syria]], as well as those holding [[Palestinian Authority passport|passports]] issued by the [[Palestinian Authority]], from entering the country. He also imposes partial restrictions on citizens from 15 other countries. [https://www.npr.org/2025/12/17/g-s1-102569/trump-expands-travel-ban-restrictions (NPR)]
*[[Egypt–Israel relations]]
**[[Israel]]i [[Prime Minister of Israel|prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] approves a deal to export US$35 billion of [[Natural gas in Israel|natural gas]] from the [[Leviathan gas field]] to [[Egypt]] over the next 15 years. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-gas-leviathan-chevron-egypt-9d7e816ae59b18f5d5cb78aadc3083e1 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Arrest of Jair Bolsonaro]]
**The [[Brazil]]ian [[Federal Senate (Brazil)|Senate]] approves a bill that reduces penalties for certain [[Crime in Brazil|crimes]], including attempted [[Coup d'état|coup]], which could significantly shorten former [[President of Brazil|president]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]]'s 27-year prison sentence. The bill now heads to [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] for signature. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-jair-bolsonaro-prison-sentence-senate-27fb5a646fb6c33353cf11eac3e7ea92 (AP)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Russia]]n [[President of Russia|president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] signs a [[Law of Russia|law]] to redistribute ownerless homes on [[Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine|occupied territories]] to those who have lost homes during the conflict. [https://euromaidanpress.com/2025/12/17/putin-signs-law-to-seize-ukrainian-homes-on-occupied-territories-until-2030/ (Euromaidan Press)]
*[[Brazil]]'s [[Supreme Federal Court]] rules that [[Indigenous land rights]] constitute unamendable [[Constitution of Brazil|constitutional]] guarantees, thereby blocking [[Brazilian National Congress|congressional]] efforts to restrict the recognition of [[Indigenous territory (Brazil)|Indigenous territories]] and reinforcing existing protections despite pending legislative opposition. [https://www.reuters.com/world/brazil-supreme-court-affirms-indigenous-land-rights-defying-congress-2025-12-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 FIFA Intercontinental Cup]]
**In [[association football]], [[Paris Saint-Germain FC|Paris Saint-Germain]] win their first [[FIFA Intercontinental Cup]] after defeating [[CR Flamengo|Flamengo]] 2–1 on [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalties]], following a 1–1 draw after [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]], in the [[2025 FIFA Intercontinental Cup final|final]] in [[Al Rayyan (city)|Al Rayyan]], [[Qatar]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/paris-st-germain-beat-flamengo-penalties-win-intercontinental-cup-2025-12-17/ (Reuters)]
